title: Municipal Service Accessibility Platform
problem: Dubai Municipality required an automated, high-precision framework to audit walkable and multi-modal accessibility deficits across civic facilities without manual GIS overhead.
architecture: Engineered a reactive web platform (React, HERE Routing API, Overture Maps, OSM) calculating dynamic multi-isochrone service catchments and spatial equity indices with real-time UI re-rendering.
impact: Delivered into live municipal workflows, directly guiding facility placement and capital street-network investments across 200+ public locations.

title: 4D Urban Climate Digital Twin (BARCLI)
problem: Translating complex, qualitative municipal climate policies into actionable, high-resolution microclimate impact assessments for public-space retrofits.
architecture: Synthesized 3D LiDAR point clouds, satellite observations (LST, NDVI, SPEI), and socio-spatial indicators. Integrated regression pipelines with SHAP explainability and an agent-based pedestrian simulation (Mesa) coupled with GPU-accelerated SOLWEIG microclimate comfort modeling (UTCI).
impact: Simulated thermal comfort improvements across 100,000 m² of public space interventions in Barcelona's Eixample district. Presented at CARTO Geospatial Foundational Models Workshop and BSC Doctoral Symposium (2026).

title: High-Throughput Cadastral Spatial Engine
problem: Querying millions of heterogeneous, unindexed Japanese cadastral records inside a web CAD/analytics tool caused severe latency and database connection bottlenecks.
architecture: Engineered an index-first ETL spatial pipeline using DuckDB and GeoParquet hosted on Cloudflare R2, streaming sliced spatial bounding boxes directly to the client via optimized REST endpoints.
impact: Reduced parcel loading times from minutes to sub-second queries across 1.6M+ plots in DBF's Hikari intelligence platform.

title: Participatory Spatial AI & Urban Flux Agent
problem: Bridging unstructured citizen survey feedback with quantitative parametric site massing in urban renewal zones without manual translation.
architecture: Built an n8n-orchestrated pipeline using Segment Anything (SAM) and Roboflow computer vision to quantify urban pedestrian flux, feeding structured resident personas directly into ComfyUI and Grasshopper parametric workflows.
impact: Automated the generation of four adaptive public-space typologies directly responding to temporal neighborhood vacancy and human sentiment.

title: Informal Settlement Mobility & Water Justice
problem: Informal settlements lacked spatial infrastructure data, leaving women and vulnerable groups exposed to severe transit and water access hazards.
architecture: Structured field survey data into standardized spatial databases, modeling pedestrian transit impedance and water access equity using PedSim and QGIS spatial network analyses.
impact: Provided municipal and NGO planners with evidence-based displacement and infrastructure intervention maps adhering strictly to GIZ ethical field protocols.

title: Wildfire Hazard & Evacuation Simulation
problem: Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) zones suffer from critical road-capacity bottlenecks during rapid wildfire propagation.
architecture: Coupled Google Earth Engine multi-temporal satellite burn indices with road-network graph centrality models to simulate evacuation egress failure under multi-front fire scenarios.
impact: Isolated high-risk evacuation corridors to assist emergency routing and vegetation management prioritization.

title: CMIP6 Climate Resilience & Flood Risk Modeling
problem: Masterplanning teams struggle to incorporate raw netCDF climate projections into early-stage site massing and feasibility calculations.
architecture: Developed automated spatial ETL pipelines downscaling global CMIP6 sea-level rise and precipitation projections into actionable raster risk layers consumable via web APIs.
impact: Directly informed flood resilience zoning and podium design for commercial planning developments across Singapore, Japan, and the UAE.

title: Automated Masterplan Massing
problem: Iterating high-density institutional masterplans manually while balancing municipal FAR limits, solar heat gain, and programmatic floor areas.
architecture: Built algorithmic Grasshopper and Python scripts automating multi-objective generative massing, coupled with real-time solar radiation and view analysis engines.
impact: Cut design exploration cycles from weeks to hours and delivered interactive Unreal Engine walkthroughs for rapid executive sign-off.
